Current HEAD does resolve the intended security/scoping fixes (`context/farm-workers.ts:20-95`, `context/farm-details.ts:158-170,216-228`, `context/farm-weather.ts:25-35`, `context/assembler.ts:258-299`), removes legacy `voice-routing.ts`, wires `farm_query` into the live handler path (`handlers/main.ts:42,243-251`), and replaces the TTS/LLM/embeddings provider suites with real module imports. The routing split is also still over the limit. Current HEAD measures `supabase/functions/ai-gateway/routing/voice-log-routing.ts` at 502 lines, so the fix does not actually satisfy the promised '<500 lines' outcome for the extracted routing modules.

The STT real-test-coverage fix never landed. This suite still asserts local literals and hand-mutated fake state (`const expectedModel = 'saaras:v3'` at line 135, `const languageCode = 'unknown'` at line 156, `simulateCircuitBreakerOpen()` at lines 103-105) instead of importing and executing the real STT module, and repo-wide test search still finds no `transcribeAudio` usage under `__tests__`. The feature explicitly required rewriting STT provider tests to import/call the real module.
